We arrive prepared to fix your door on the first visit. We offer upfront, flat-rate quotes before any work begins. This means you know the total cost before we start. For urgent repairs, our technicians are available 24 hours a day, Monday through Saturday. Book your cable repair online and receive a 10% discount.
localContext: Lombard's older homes often feature aging garage structures. Bungalows near Lilacia Park, built in the 1920s, commonly have detached garages. These buildings can settle unevenly on Lombard's clay soil. This causes door openings to go out of square, especially with seasonal freeze-thaw cycles. Garage doors in these older frames develop track pinch points, stressing lift cables. Similarly, 1960s and 70s ranches in areas like Yorktown and Westmore have attached garages. Their original springs and cables are nearing or past their design life. Repeated use on doors that drift out of balance due to shifting foundations contributes to cable wear. We understand these local issues.

problemSigns.detail: This indicates a cable has slipped from its pulley or drum, or it has snapped.

problemSigns.detail: Damaged cables or drums can rub against other components, creating friction and noise.

problemSigns.sign: Door slams down faster than normal
problemSigns.detail: When a cable fails, the spring system loses its counterbalance, causing the door to drop rapidly.
